select_shape_xld — 2D contour op

• Data kinds: contour → contour

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "select_shape_xld", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: select_shape_xld (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

A filter that discards XLD contours with too few points. Removes contours whose vertex count is fewer than `3+40a` points. b is unused.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

HALCON の `select_shape_xld`（面積・円形度・凸性など多様な形状特徴で XLD 輪郭を選別する演算）とは異なり、この実装は頂点数（≈輪郭の長さ）という単一の特徴でしか選別できない簡略近似。
